title: Developer Guide for metabr
text: Welcome developer guide metabr (v0.2.3), R package foundr / systems genetics ecosystem designed metabolite data ingestion, quality control (QC) batch correction, normalization, curation discrepancy analysis. document details package architecture, data models, developer environment setup, core QC algorithms, S3 class definitions, testing procedures, release guidelines.

title: Developer Guide for metabr
text: metabr serves metabolite data ingestion standardization layer. takes raw peak-area spreadsheets output El-MAVEN LC-MS mass spectrometry platforms, applies quality control sample batch corrections across runs/plates/batches, exports normalized datasets downstream analysis (foundrHarmony →\rightarrowfoundr →\rightarrowfoundrShiny).

title: QC Pipeline & Correction Methodology
text: Plate QC Average: MeanPlate(c,medRt,b,p)=1|QCb,p|∑∈QCb,pyi,c,medRt\text{Mean}_{\text{Plate}}(c, \text{medRt}, b, p) = \frac{1}{|\text{QC}_{b,p}|} \sum_{\\text{QC}_{b,p}} y_{, c, \text{medRt}} Global QC Average: MeanGlobal(c,medRt)=1|QCtotal|∑∈QCtotalyi,c,medRt\text{Mean}_{\text{Global}}(c, \text{medRt}) = \frac{1}{|\text{QC}_{\text{total}}|} \sum_{\\text{QC}_{\text{total}}} y_{, c, \text{medRt}} Plate Correction Factor (CF): CFb,p,c,medRt=MeanPlate(c,medRt,b,p)MeanGlobal(c,medRt)\text{CF}_{b, p, c, \text{medRt}} = \frac{\text{Mean}_{\text{Plate}}(c, \text{medRt}, b, p)}{\text{Mean}_{\text{Global}}(c, \text{medRt})} Batch-Corrected Sample Intensity: ycorrected,=yraw,iCFb,p,c,medRty_{\text{corrected}, } = \frac{y_{\text{raw}, }}{\text{CF}_{b, p, c, \text{medRt}}}

title: QC Pipeline & Correction Methodology
text: untargeted metabolomics, LC-MS platforms may output multiple chromatographic peaks per compound corresponding different retention times. Untargeted Assays: Grouping performed across (compound, medRt) pairs ensure peak independently corrected. Targeted Assays: Grouping defaults compound medRt unique.

title: QC Pipeline & Correction Methodology
text: evaluate automated QC correction manual expert curation, hand_auto() calculates compound-wise ratios across samples: Ratio=ValuehandValueauto\text{Ratio} = \frac{\text{Value}_{\text{hand}}}{\text{Value}_{\text{auto}}} Visualizing resulting ratio automated value estimates (log⁡10\log_{10} scale) per batch plate allows rapid detection systematic curation biases outlier plates.
